protocol: Debug build, swift test --filter ZZScrollHarness with SCROLL_HARNESS=1 (scroll-harness.swift). One process per run; each run opens History then Clipboard at stride 40 pt, then both again at stride 120 pt, each in its own offscreen window that is closed and checked freed before the next. Rounds d-i alternate before/after in time order; j is one more run of the committed source. Store: 179 history rows with real thumbnails, 49 clipboard rows, read only. Heap figures are malloc_zone_statistics size_in_use in MB. Instructions and CPU ms are for the whole scroll pass; main_* from thread_selfcounts / CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID on the main thread, process_* from proc_pid_rusage. Frame timing is wall time per 8.33 ms frame slot and depends on machine load (load average 4-90 across rounds).
machine: Apple M5 MacBook Air, 16 GB, macOS 26.7.2
